# Landscape themes

Requires Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, and configured Tailwind CSS 4 with its base reset.

Import the default export from this folder's index.tsx and render <LandscapeThemes />. The entry point imports all styles and fonts and owns the feedback provider.

The assets/*.asset.ts modules contain the original image bytes, dimensions, and data URLs so installation is self-contained. Original WebP files remain in the GitHub source folder.

Data and interactions are local demonstrations.
